next.reason: 1985: 'Within a given report group description entry a NEXT PAGE phrase may appear only once and, if present, must be in the first LINE NUMBER clause in that report group description entry.' §2023:13.18.35.3 SR7: 'Within a given report group description, a NEXT PAGE phrase, if present, shall be specified only in the first LINE clause.' A 1985 LINE NUMBER clause has one operand, so 'only in the first' is also 'only once'. ADJUDICATED 2026-11-10 (band-85 slice 13): §2023:13.18.35.3 SR10 removed; it governs 'a multiple LINE clause' ('more than one integer-1 or integer-2 operand'), which the 1985 format cannot write.
